title: DFM for injection moulding
description: Mouldability rules for a straight-pull tool: draft on every wall, fillable walls, rounded internal corners.

pull.description: Mould opening direction: x, y or z.

min_draft_deg.description: Smallest draft per side (degrees): 1-2 smooth, 3+ textured.

min_wall.description: Thinnest wall (mm) that still fills for common thermoplastics.

min_internal_radius.description: Smallest internal corner radius (mm); about 0.5 x wall thickness.

rules.citation: Guideline: injection moulding needs 1-2 degrees of draft per side on untextured faces parallel to the mould opening direction
Guideline: walls thinner than about 1 mm risk short shots in common thermoplastics; check the resin supplier's flow-length data
Guideline: internal corner radius of about 0.5 x wall thickness limits stress concentration and helps the melt flow
ISO 2768-1:1989, Table 1 (permissible deviations for linear dimensions); process capability per DUCAD guideline
rules.note: Moulded plastics are normally toleranced per ISO 20457; ISO 2768-m is only a first estimate.
